description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests for configuring wireless network settings, including WiFi radio and SSID configurations, WPS setup, filtering, and other WLAN management functions on a network device.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates WPS PIN checksum for 4 or 8 digit PIN codes.

methods.name: validFilterParam
methods.description: Validates filter parameters, ensuring printable characters and valid MAC addresses.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies settings for a specific SSID by manipulating configuration parameters.
